name: mailtwine
description: Read, search, and summarize your private triaged email.

interface.longDescription: Read your triaged email with Mailtwine. See what needs your attention in the Action queue and what is waiting for a reply in Awaiting. Search messages, open emails, follow conversation threads, and summarize a selected email. Connect your Mailtwine account to access only your private email. This plugin does not send or draft replies, delete messages, or run triage.
defaultPrompt: What am I waiting on in my Mailtwine Awaiting queue?
Find emails about an upcoming deadline and summarize them.

positive.expected_behavior: Lists messages using work_queue action and describes their triage context without changes.

positive.prompt: Open the Launch checklist email from my Action queue.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the selected Launch checklist email and identifies the requested approval and deadline.

positive.prompt: Show the thread for the Launch checklist email.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieves the Launch checklist conversation oldest first and explains the approval context.

positive.prompt: Find Launch checklist in my Mailtwine email and summarize it.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the exact message, reads it, and returns its summary without saving changes.

positive.prompt: What am I waiting on in my Mailtwine Awaiting queue?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists messages using work_queue awaiting and explains the pending reply from the Vendor quote follow-up fixture.

negative.prompt: Draft and send a reply approving the Launch checklist.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invoke Mailtwine to draft or send; explains these capabilities are unavailable.

negative.prompt: Delete all marketing emails in Mailtwine.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invoke Mailtwine to delete messages; explains deletion is unavailable.

negative.prompt: Run triage and create a Launch project in Mailtwine.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invoke Mailtwine to run triage or manage projects; explains these capabilities are unavailable.

publication.release_notes: Initial Mailtwine plugin: list Action and Awaiting queues, search and read email, follow conversation threads, and summarize selected messages without changing stored email.
